Coram : S.S.M. QUADRI, S.N. VARIAVA
B Code of Civil Procedure, 1908: S.100-Second appeal-Substantial question of law-High Court deciding second appeal without framing substantial question of law though it C formulated points which arose for its consideration-Held, it is manifest that High Court can entertain a second appeal only if appellant to state precisely the substantial question of law involved in the case in the memorandum of second appeal and if the High Court is satisfied that a D substantial question of law is involved in the case, it is required to formulate that question-Interference by High Court in second
